# FitWow

> FitWow is a calorie and nutrition tracking app for iOS and Android. It combines a searchable database of 3.3 million foods and products with photo, text, voice, barcode, saved-meal, and manual logging.

## Product facts

- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, and Android.
- Canonical identifiers: Apple App Store ID 6760663683; Android package com.fitwow.fitwow.
- Category: Health and fitness; calorie and nutrition tracking.
- Food database: 3.3 million searchable branded and generic foods and products.
- Meal input: database search, photo, text, voice, barcode, recent and saved meals, and manual entry. These are complementary methods in the same app.
- Tracks: calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fiber, sugar, sodium, water, weight, exercise, and fasting.
- Additional features: personalized nutrition goals, an AI coach, meal-effect and symptom history, allergen awareness, progress charts, community challenges, and supported health-platform connections.
- Languages: 24.
- Pricing: free to download with optional in-app subscriptions; offers and prices can vary by platform and region.
